name: nextup
description: Next up: open threads and today's plan, plus this session's turn, permissions, helpers, files touched and log, in one pane.

dataDir.title: Data folder
dataDir.description: Folder holding the board's threads.json and notes.json (and optionally build.py, calendar.json, drafts.json). Leave empty to show this session's activity only.

openOnStart.title: Open on start
openOnStart.description: Open the Next up pane when a session starts. Turn off to open it only with /nextup.

dispatchDir.title: Worker dispatch folder
dispatchDir.description: Folder of the worker dispatch skill. When set, the Session tab shows a worker fast mode toggle. Leave empty to use DISPATCH_ROOT, or to hide the toggle.

reloadHelper.title: Reload helper script
reloadHelper.description: Optional path to a script that updates plugins and reloads open sessions in place (takes --plugin ID --json). Leave empty to update the plugin and be told to type /reload-plugins.
